paragraphs: Abba Yose Chali Kufri of Tivon: beginning of Makhshirin, mishnah 3: the House of Shammai says, and so forth. Rabbi Yehoshua said in Abba Yose’s name, and so forth. An epithet for his town; Arukh writes that it is a name epithet. Maimonides explains: Chalifkori is an epithet, and Tivon is his place-name. In Sifrei: Rabbi Chanina of Tivon.
